recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed unless a future work-group decision changes how DomainResource search parameters should be represented for tooling compatibility.
issue_request: FHIR-43407 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-I change request for R6 asking to remove the `_text` search parameter from the Resource search-parameter list because `_text` is defined on DomainResource.
initial_application: The issue was applied by source commit 412487b6a6021026b47e7166d699a5d2cc3ae2c8, which deleted the `Resource-_text` SearchParameter entry from `source/resource/bundle-Resource-search-params.xml`.
additional_context: FHIR-9701 records the same older Resource-versus-DomainResource `_text` placement correction, the 2024-05-06 FHIR-I minutes approved removing `_text` from Resource, Zulip discussion supported trying the fix, and FHIR-49657 later reaffirmed that `_text` cannot be on Resource because Resource has no narrative.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the active build source is already correct: `source/fhir.ini` lists Resource and DomainResource as active resources, `source/resource/bundle-Resource-search-params.xml` has no `Resource-_text`, and `source/domainresource/bundle-DomainResource-search-params.xml` retains `DomainResource-_text`.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published issue identified that `_text` belonged on DomainResource rather than Resource because only DomainResource has narrative.
Later Resolved - No Change/Retracted report asked whether DomainResource search parameters were improper; the comment reaffirmed that `_text` cannot be on Resource.
